flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Consumer Durables is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.80) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

strengths.point: Promoters hold a controlling majority - skin in the game.
Consumer Durables is in a tailwind - the macro backdrop is supportive.

weaknesses.point: The share price has run ahead of the fundamentals.
Institutional money has been flowing out.
weaknesses.evidence: NEGATIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change -0.28 pp

weaknesses.point: The institutional holding trend has been falling for 4 quarters in a row.
weaknesses.evidence: Institutional Holding trend (quarterly): Decreasing for 4 quarters

weaknesses.point: Foreign institutions have been cutting their stake.
Domestic institutions have been cutting their stake.

opportunities.point: The company expects around 60% revenue growth for the coming year.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "And just coming year also we are looking out for growth around 60% from last year." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Management targets around 35% to 40% volume growth for FY27.
The Board recently approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary in the United Arab Emirates.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Our Board recently approved the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary in the United Arab Emirates." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: The company plans a capex of around INR50 crores for the year.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Yes, around INR50 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: A consumer durables tailwind can lift earnings without the company doing anything different.
Management stated that the demand for jewelry in India is very high.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "See the demand is too much about jewelry in India." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Demand was driven by festive and wedding seasons, repeat business, and deeper penetration.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "During the year, we witnessed healthy demand driven by festive and wedding seasons, sales repeat business from existing customers, and deeper penetration across both existing and new markets." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Current manufacturing capacity stands at around 2,500 kilos.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Current capacity is around 2,500 kilos." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Capacity utilization is managed at around 65% overall and goes up to 90% in season.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Around 65%. So, in season it goes up to 90% and it's like managed 65% overall." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

opportunities.point: Real diamond jewelry sales are expected to reach more than INR200 crores in a couple of years.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "And like in couple of years, we should be reaching around more than INR200 crores." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [next 2 years]

opportunities.point: Capacity utilization is expected to reach around 70% to 75% this year.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So, that's what I am saying, from 65% it is going to go up to 75%." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01) [FY27]

opportunities.point: Export sales are expected to jump up to 10% to 20% immediately once the UAE subsidiary starts.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "So, once if UAE subsidiary starts, so its export sales will jump up to 10% to 20% immediately." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Institutional holding keeps falling - the selling has not stopped.
threats.evidence: Institutional Holding trend (quarterly): Decreasing for 4 quarters

threats.point: Both foreign and domestic institutions have been reducing.
threats.evidence: FII -2.62 pp, DII -1.56 pp over the recent quarters

threats.point: A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Management noted risks related to gold price volatility impacting margins.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "• Gold price volatility impacting margins" (concall ppt - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Management noted that gold price fluctuations impact percentage-wise margins.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Largely, percentage-wise, margins are impacted." (concall transcript - 2025-11-01)

swot.verdict: Opportunities dominate the evidence (S4/W9/O28/T10), led by 'The company expects around 60% revenue growth for the coming year', so the case leans on things that are not in the reported numbers yet.
